Schema records structural shape; native financial reconciliation and conditional rules below are mandatory.
input.financialSemantics: paymentDate valid calendar and numeric amount required; optional note string <=2000 bytes (empty accepted), optional journalEntryId/bankTransactionId positive safe numeric ids.
